method: run.sh.txt ran HermiT once on each input. Its comparison step passed ELK's taxonomy to el-oracle.py in the wrong form, so oracle.sh.txt made the retained comparisons again from the same taxonomies without running HermiT: scripts/el-oracle.py HERMIT.ofn OURS.txt against the classifier, and ref-compare.py.txt HERMIT.ofn ELK.ofn, which reads two reference files with el-oracle's own reader and counts the classes either side names alone. compare.jsonl holds both reports, hermit.jsonl HermiT's JSON lines and cases/ the four test ontologies with each tool's taxonomy. HermiT ran on one thread; the threads field of hermit.jsonl gives the unused --threads default of that harness version.
scale: 36 ORE 2015 EL ontologies with nominals, SameIndividual, ranges with assertions or top-property axioms, and four range test ontologies
